6 ANALYTICS MODULES

Every metric has three parts:
The number. The insight. The action.

If a metric can't generate an action, it doesn't belong on the dashboard. Every visualization produces a specific, dollar-quantified recommendation.

Revenue Forecast

Predictive revenue modeling using historical Toast data. Trend analysis, seasonal pattern detection, and growth rate computation.

“Projected March revenue: $368K (+7.6% MoM)”

Revenue Mix / Menu Intelligence

Item-level performance, BCG matrix positioning, server performance scoring, and menu volatility tracking across every sales category.

“Espresso Martini is a Star — high volume, high margin. Protect it.”
FLAGSHIP

Competitive Landscape

Full competitive intelligence radar: market share, geographic pressure index, competitor monitoring, new entrant alerts, closure detection, and 3D time-lapse mapping.

“3 competitors closed — $62K/mo freed. Your wine mix is 16% below market.”

Profitability / Labor Analytics

Labor cost analysis, revenue-per-labor-hour efficiency, shift-level profitability, overtime tracking, and staffing optimization recommendations.

“Friday 8PM–12AM: $4,200/labor-hour. Monday lunch: $890. Cut 2 positions.”

Sentiment Analysis

Customer feedback pattern analysis from reviews and operational signals. Identifies satisfaction trends, complaint categories, and service quality issues.

“Negative sentiment spikes correlate with understaffed Friday late-night shifts.”

Executive Summary

AI-generated executive briefing synthesizing all modules into a single-page overview with the top 3 actions you should take this week.

“This week: (1) Wine launch (2) Adjust Friday staffing (3) Geo-campaign near closure”

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Got questions?

SignalTAP combines two data sources: public TABC (Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission) revenue filings — which include monthly liquor, wine, beer, and total receipts for every licensed establishment — and your private Toast POS transaction data. This fusion is what enables real competitive intelligence: TABC tells you what competitors earned, Toast tells you what you earned, and SignalTAP computes the gap.
Yes — SignalTAP connects to your Toast POS through Toast's API, which requires Toast's Restaurant Management Suite. This is a Toast fee, not a SignalTAP fee. If you're already on Toast's paid plans, you're good to go.
The competitor data comes directly from TABC public filings — these are the actual reported revenue numbers that establishments file with the state of Texas. This is not estimated foot traffic, review sentiment, or survey data. It is real, reported revenue broken down by liquor, wine, beer, and cover charges.
Most venues are live within 48 hours. We connect your Toast API, run your historical data through the analytics pipeline, and your intelligence dashboard is online. The TABC dataset covering 35,987 records across 1,393 Houston locations is already loaded and waiting.
Toast Analytics shows your own data — it cannot see competitor revenue. Avero provides anonymized network benchmarks, not granular competitor data. SignalTAP is the only platform that fuses public TABC filings with private POS data to compute real market share, peer benchmarks, category mix gaps, and new entrant detection. No other hospitality tool has this capability.
